<!-- One or two sentences describing the request. Add the `bug` or `enhancement` label to set the type.
     e.g. Add a calculator page to the web app that performs basic arithmetic on two numbers. -->

### Objective
<!-- The business outcome this should achieve.
     e.g. Let support staff do quick sums inside the app instead of switching to a phone calculator. -->

### Problem Statement
<!-- The problem or opportunity, and who is affected.
     e.g. Support staff copy figures into an external calculator, which is slow and causes typing mistakes. -->

### Scope
<!-- What is in scope (features/changes).
     e.g. Add, subtract, multiply and divide two decimal numbers; a Calculator page at /tools/calculator. -->

### Out of Scope
<!-- What is explicitly excluded, or "none".
     e.g. Scientific functions, calculation history. -->

### Expected Behavior
<!-- What should happen after the change.
     e.g. The user enters two numbers, picks an operation and sees the result rounded to 2 decimals;
          dividing by zero shows "Cannot divide by zero". -->

### Actual Behavior
<!-- Bugs only: what happens today.
     e.g. Dividing -10 by 4 shows 2.50 -->

### Steps to Reproduce
<!-- Bugs only: numbered steps.
     e.g. 1. Open /tools/calculator  2. Enter -10 and 4  3. Choose Divide -->

### Acceptance Criteria
<!-- Testable bullets, e.g. "Given X, when Y, then Z". Avoid vague words like fast/easy without a number.
     e.g. - Given 7 and 5, when I choose Add, then the result is 12
          - Given 10 and 0, when I choose Divide, then "Cannot divide by zero" is shown -->
- 

### Dependencies
<!-- Or "none".  e.g. none -->

### Technical Constraints
<!-- Or "none".  e.g. Go standard library only; result in under 100 ms. -->

### Security / Compliance
<!-- Requirements, or explicitly "none".  e.g. none (no personal data is stored or sent) -->
